english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an assurance that something will happen or be true.
This is the all-purpose noun for an outward assurance, promise, or guarantee intended to reassure someone.
Use this for a legal or contractual warranty that guarantees the condition or quality of goods or property.
Use this when the reassurance is an explicit assurance, promise, or confirmation from someone.
Use this when security means a guarantee securing an obligation, rather than physical collateral.

examples.english: There’s no guarantee this offer won’t be cancelled at any time.
examples.traditional: 呢個優惠冇保證，可能隨時取消。
